d: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.
In the 1930s Texas, Mel Tolson inspires students at a predominantly black college to form a debate team and strive for the national championship.
In the 1970s an aficionado (Terrence Howard) and a janitor (Bernie Mac) renovate an abandoned pool and establish a swim team in one of Philadelphia's roughest neighborhoods.
Flashbacks reveal the last day in the life of Oscar Grant (Michael B. Jordan), a young man shot dead during an altercation with California police.
Romantic sparks fly between a wealthy businessman and a struggling single mother who works as a cleaner in his office building.
